Own-residual check, reading EO 13080 in full (secs. 1-4): it established an advisory committee to review community nominations and recommend rivers for designation as American Heritage Rivers, with administrative support from the Department of Defense (Army Civil Works); it transferred no function, fund or property, revoked or amended no other order and created no right. The rivers actually designated rest on the parent initiative order EO 13061 (sec. 2(d)(1)), which EO 13093 amended in the same sentence and which EO 13225 does not revoke; those designations are not rights or duties of EO 13080. research_rationale: EO 13080 (signed 1998-04-07, 63 FR 17667), read in full from the held FR text, establishes the American Heritage Rivers Initiative Advisory Committee, sets its review and recommendation functions (sec. 2), administration (sec. 3) and ends it 'no later than 2 years from the date of this order' (sec. 4). The one machine own-term lead is that fixed term (computed 2000-04-07); no clause carries a report deadline. EO 13093 (63 FR 40357, held FR text, read in full), signed 1998-07-27, amended only the second sentence of sec. 2(a) ('ten' to 'up to 20') and is attached as a later event on the sec. 2 clause; it did not extend the Committee. Extension check: no order in the held corpus continues or extends the Committee (a by-number scan of all 6,652 held FR-original texts finds EO 13080 named only in EO 13093 and EO 13225, and a name search for 'American Heritage Rivers' finds only EO 13061, 13080, 13093 and 13225), so the Committee's own term ended no later than 2000-04-07. EO 13225 sec. 3(b) (66 FR 50291; reading record scale/readings/LSP-EO_13225.json) revokes the order effective 2001-09-30 as one for a committee that had terminated, so it is a later event, not the first end. Limit: the term is stated as 'no later than', so the Committee may have ended earlier; no held source gives an earlier date, and the outer date is used as the dated own-terms end. The dossier lists no missing provision. The dossier's 17 clauses cover secs. 1 to 4 without gap or overlap (the text of sec. 2(b)(3) with its items (A)-(J) is one clause). Savings: the S0 prefill is kept.
